natalie (DevEx): Quick report from today's onboarding lab with the next-samplekit: Codespaces + Vercel preview users are hitting intermittent 403s and a confusing duplicate-chat symptom when the sample uses an API-middleware proxy. Repro + small logs below.

ryan (SDK): Can you paste the minimal server proxy and client init you used?

natalie (DevEx): Server proxy (pages/api/chat.js): ```js
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-sdk'
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, retry: { maxRetries: 2, backoffMs: 300 } })
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const stream = await client.generateStream({ model: 'redwood/gpt-lite', prompt: req.body.prompt })
  stream.on('data', c => res.write(`data: ${c}\n\n`))
  stream.on('end', () => res.end())
}
```
Client just opens EventSource('/api/chat'). Logs from a repro: ```
[2025-04-07T14:12:03Z] proxy -> /v1/generate 401 {"message":"invalid api key"}
[2025-04-07T14:12:03Z] sdk.retry auth -> refresh token
[2025-04-07T14:12:08Z] proxy -> /v1/generate 200 (stream started)
[2025-04-07T14:12:08Z] proxy: wrote chunk id=1
[2025-04-07T14:12:08Z] proxy: wrote chunk id=2
```
Sometimes the browser receives both the partial first stream and the retried full stream -> duplicated assistant message. Other times EventSource seems to hang after the retry and no further updates arrive.

wei (Eng): Sounds like a combination of two things: (1) the retry wrapper is replaying a streaming request without preserving/reattaching the original stream handlers, and (2) the serverless proxy can buffer/flush partial bytes so the retried stream gets appended to leftover fragments.

claire (Docs): For onboarding docs we need clear guidance: Codespaces and Vercel previews are common for new users; mention the proxy pattern caveat and give workarounds.

ryan (SDK): Agreed. Short-term options: set retry.maxRetries=0 on streaming routes in the sample, or send an Idempotency-Key per session so the backend can dedupe duplicate runs. Long-term: SDK changes to detect stream-producing endpoints and special-case auth errors. Plan:
1) If a stream has emitted bytes, treat 401/403 as non-retryable (so we don't replay partial streams).
2) Add optional idempotencyKey header support for generate/agent/eval endpoints.
3) When we must replay a stream (non-auth transient), ensure we reattach handlers or return an explicit error so app can reopen cleanly.

natalie (DevEx): Workaround I validated in staging: change proxy client init to `retry: { maxRetries: 0 }` for the streaming route + add a simple session-based idempotency key: `await client.generate({ prompt, idempotencyKey: sessionId })`. That eliminated duplicates in our demo.

e2e-bot: CI: examples/next-samplekit/tests streaming-auth-repro queued (job #1189).

claire (Docs): I'll add a Troubleshooting section to the starter README: short snippet showing how to disable retries for streaming endpoints and how to pass idempotency keys, plus a Codespaces/Vercel preview note. Draft blurb: "If your chat shows duplicated paragraphs after a sign-in/preview deploy, set `retry.maxRetries: 0` for streaming proxy routes or upgrade to SDK v0.11.3+ which preserves stream semantics."

ryan (SDK): I'll land a canary with the streaming guard + idempotency header (v0.11.3-canary-stream) and open a PR to bump the example's package.json. Also adding an e2e test that simulates 401->200 with partial chunk then final stream.

wei (Eng): On the service side we'll add a lightweight dedupe by Idempotency-Key for 2 minutes as a safety net so duplicate POSTs don't create duplicate records. Also adding telemetry flag `stream:auth_retry` so observability surfaces these incidents quickly.

natalie (DevEx): Thanks 1 1 I'll update the quickstart workshop checklist: "If your live demo hangs or duplicates, try: 1) disabling streaming retries in the proxy; 2) enable idempotency keys; 3) upgrade to SDK canary and rerun smoke tests."

ryan (SDK): PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2124 (streaming-retry-guard + idempotency). Will post canary npm link once CI completes.

claire (Docs): I'll also add a one-line Codespaces tip: "If you use Codespaces, ensure RW_KEY is set in both Codespace env and in Vercel preview envs when testing previews to avoid auth mismatch confusion."

natalie (DevEx): Closing the loop for now. Once canary lands we'll bump the template and remove the workaround. If anyone still hits weird dupes after upgrade ping me and we'll triage. :rocket:
